$comment: Neutral receiving contract derived independently from HL7 FHIR R5 Observation concepts.

bodySiteCode.description: Coded anatomical site of the observation.

clinicallyEffectiveAt.description: Time when the measured fact was clinically true.

encounterReference.description: Healthcare encounter connected to the result.

interpretationCode.description: Coded interpretation such as high, low, or normal.

isFinal.description: Whether the result is final rather than preliminary.

measurementCode.description: Clinical code identifying what was measured.

measurementUnit.description: Unit carried with the numeric result.

observationIdentifier.description: Stable business key for the clinical observation.

recordedAt.description: Relevant observation timestamp; the receiving workflow must choose clinical-effective or publication semantics.

referenceRangeHigh.description: Upper bound of the applicable reference range.

responsibleParty.description: Party responsible for the asserted observation.

specimenIdentifier.description: Identifier of the specimen used for the observation.

subjectReference.description: Patient or subject reference for the measurement.
